column1: # Boot-object payload manifest -- the single source of truth for what gets
# The entry point column exists because getting it wrong is the most expensive
# mistake this project has made. m1n1 was installed at 0, so it never ran, was
# judged useless, and was abandoned -- removing the only debugging instrument
# available (BRINGUP_PLAN.md item 1). Our stub really is entry 0. The two are
# different and must never be copied from one another, so they are recorded
# here per payload rather than typed per invocation.
# Hashes were taken on the workstation and again on the mini under macOS.
# recoveryOS has no shasum, no openssl and no Perl Digest::SHA -- all three
# were tried on the real machine -- so scripts running there fall back to the
# size column, and the hash stands as the record of what that size means.
#   name  file  bytes  sha256  entry_point  lowest_virtual_address  source
